version.value: Russian folk song arranged by Fyodor Chaliapin and Fyodor Keneman; bass and orchestra
version.note: The label spells the second arranger Koenemann. The arrangement, not an anonymous unarranged folk performance, is heard.

performers.note: DAHR supplies the conductor; no ensemble identity is inferred.

matrixTakeSides.note: The inspected Victrola label reads 88663 and credits both arrangers. IA repeats 88663 in its matrix field; DAHR identifies the actual matrix as Cc1891, take 4. DAHR’s [1922] publication year is explicitly bracketed.

credits.note: The archive names the transfer operator and scanning centre, not the original recording engineer.

date.note: Upload dates are not treated as transfer dates.

processing.value: Transferred at 78 rpm using four truncated-conical styli: 3.8, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.3 mil. The named MP3 derives from the archive’s preferred FLAC.
processing.note: Surface noise and transfer equalisation prevent absolute sound-quality or loudness comparisons.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Traditional melody; Chaliapin–Keneman arrangement is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: DAHR identifies the arrangers as Chaliapin (1873–1938) and Keneman (1873–1937). No claim of worldwide clearance is made.

recording.value: US public domain: sound recording published before the 1925 cutoff
recording.note: The inspected Victrola label reads 88663 and credits both arrangers. IA repeats 88663 in its matrix field; DAHR identifies the actual matrix as Cc1891, take 4. DAHR’s [1922] publication year is explicitly bracketed. No non-commercial licence is present in the inspected archive metadata.
